itemList.description: Providing  waterproof treatment to retaining wall / slope slab / sunken slab or all vertical slabs  using fully bonded TPO memrane work - over the prepared concrete deck application of GAF everguard 60mil TPO white with roll size of 10'0"x100'0" mebrane shall be fully bonded using TPO bonding adhesive not more than 32 meter square per pail coverage . Bonding adhesive shall be applied on the both the surface ( mebrane and substrate )  over lapping the two membrane shall be 75mm , membrane shall have minimum of 40mm side and end laps  which shall not be hot air welded with minimum of 40mm side and end laps which shall be not air welded with automatic heat welded machine . Membrane is 100 % UV resistance , Ozone resistance according to ASTM  D1149 . Few complicated detailing like I section penentration shall be detailed using prodetail PMMA liquid applied system which is rapid setting and has excellent bonding on multiply surfaces . Over the vertical surface GAF everguard 60mil TPO white with roll size 10'0"x100'0" shall be taken up by minimum 1000mm fully bonded using TPO bonding adhesive on the vertical parapet wall . All the end on the vertical side on the membrane shall be mechanically terminated with batten termination bar with nail  and sealed with water block sealent and flexseal sealant . All the detailing like inside corners , our side corners pipe penetrations , upstands etc shall be detailed with UN55 TPO flashing as per manufacturere specifications

Providing Waterproof treatment to the cracks using 1 coat of bondcoat of SBR latex and Cement at the ratio 1:1 and then preparing Cement Mortar of 1:3 admixed with SBR latex at a dosage of 15% of Cement. SBR latex confirming to BS 6319 part 2:1983 & ASTM C 190-85. Cure for 5 days. Apply singlecomponent, cold applied, water based acrylic and UV resistant water proofing & protector conforming to ASTM D 412-1992 & ASTM E 1980-01. ( PU sealant ) The surface shall be prepared free of dust, fungus, loose & hard particles etc.. The cracks are sealed with crack x-shrink free sealing paste as per direction of Engineer in charge.

Providing and fixing double scaffolding system (cup lock type) on the exterior side of building/structure, upto 25 metre height, above ground level, including additional rows of scaffolding in stepped manner as per requirement of site, made with 40mm dia M.S. tube, placed 1.5 metre centre to centre, horizontal & vertical tubes joint with cup & lock system with M.S. Tubes, M.S. tube challis, M.S. clamps and staircase system in the scaffolding for working platform etc. and maintaining it in a serviceable condition for execution of work of cleaning and/ or pointing and/ or applying chemical and removing it thereafter. The scaffolding system shall be stiffened with bracings, runners, connecting with the building etc, wherever required, if feasible, for inspection of work at required locations with essential safety features for the workmen etc., complete as per directions and approval of Engineer-in-charge.
